title: Planned Maintenance: NBN Services via Footscray (VIC) POI
current_summary: The scheduled maintenance at the Footscray (VIC) NBN Point of Interconnect (POI) is complete. Services have been moved from older network connections to new ones. The work finished at 3:00 am AEDT on Tuesday 20 October 2026.

cause.reason: Planned maintenance to move services from legacy network connections to new ones at the Footscray NBN Point of Interconnect (POI).

updates.content: We have scheduled maintenance at the Footscray (VIC) NBN Point of Interconnect (POI). The work will take place between 12:00 am and 3:00 am AEDT on Tuesday 20 October 2026. During this time, we will be moving services from older network connections to new ones. NBN services connected through this POI may be disrupted for up to 3 hours within the window. We will post an update if anything changes.

The scheduled maintenance at the Footscray (VIC) NBN Point of Interconnect (POI) has started. NBN services connected through this POI may be disrupted for up to 3 hours, until about 3:00 am AEDT on Tuesday 20 October 2026. We will post another update when the work is complete.

The scheduled maintenance at the Footscray (VIC) NBN Point of Interconnect (POI) was completed at 3:00 am AEDT on Tuesday 20 October 2026. NBN services connected through this POI should now be running normally on the new network connections. If you are still having problems with your service, please restart your modem and contact our support team if the issue continues.
